description: Unit tests for certificate utility functions in the transport security state generator, including certificate parsing, SPKI hash calculation, and subject name extraction.

methods.name: GetX509CertificateFromPEM
methods.description: Parses a PEM-encoded certificate or public key into an X509 structure.

methods.name: CalculateSPKIHashFromCertificate
methods.description: Calculates the SPKI hash from an X509 certificate.

methods.name: CalculateSPKIHashFromKey
methods.description: Calculates the SPKI hash from a PEM-encoded public key.

methods.name: ExtractSubjectNameFromCertificate
methods.description: Extracts the subject name from an X509 certificate, defaulting to CN or organization + OU.
